sub_graphs.title: EIP-5069: EIP Editor Governance Process
sub_graphs.description: Models the governance state transitions for EIP editor membership and consensus decisions (Meta EIP - no protocol runtime behavior)

nodes.label: Editor Candidate Proposed
nodes.description: An individual has been proposed for EIP editor membership

nodes.label: Evaluate Candidate Qualifications
nodes.description: Existing editors evaluate candidate against membership requirements

nodes.label: Rough Consensus Determination
nodes.description: Keeper of Consensus determines rough consensus per RFC 2418 model

external_entities.name: Editor Candidate
external_entities.description: Individual proposed for EIP editor role

external_entities.name: Keeper of Consensus
external_entities.description: Designated editor who determines rough consensus outcomes

ambiguities.text: The 'rough consensus' approach adapted from RFC 2418 is referenced without precise definition
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume rough consensus means general agreement without requiring unanimity, with the Keeper having final authority to determine when consensus exists.

implicit_assumptions.description: EIP editors act as neutral archivists and do not use their position to favor particular proposals
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Biased editors could delay or obstruct competing proposals, centralizing influence over Ethereum protocol development

implicit_assumptions.description: The Keeper of Consensus acts in good faith when determining rough consensus
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Corrupted Keeper could manufacture false consensus, admitting or removing editors arbitrarily
